name: How do I know the wall is ready for drywall repair after a pipe leak?
description: Wait until the plumbing repair is fully pressure-tested and all framing and insulation are completely dry before installing new drywall.

mainEntity.name: How do I know the wall is ready for drywall repair after a pipe leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should never patch drywall while moisture is present inside the wall cavity. Before scheduling drywall installation, ensure the plumbing repair has undergone pressure testing to confirm zero leaks, and verify that all framing studs and remaining drywall are thoroughly dry. If insulation got wet, it must be removed and replaced. Closing up a damp cavity traps moisture, which leads to mold growth, wood rot, and crumbling joint compound within weeks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wait until the plumbing repair is fully pressure-tested and all framing and insulation are completely dry before installing new drywall.
